source_structure.documented_architecture: MCP stdio -> server.py -> bridge.py -> rhinocode -> Rhino 8 / Grasshopper
source_structure.server_role: Thin MCP tool surface importing transport operations from bridge.py and runtime helpers from tool_support.py.
source_structure.bridge_role: Host-side rhinocode transport, discovery, target selection, persistent jobs, result-file handshakes, timeout handling, and exception capture.

supporting_modules.runtime_ops.py: Host/Rhino operation implementations used by the MCP tool layer.
supporting_modules.tool_support.py: Tool targeting, runtime dispatch, and code checks.
supporting_modules.knowledge/: Bundled Grasshopper capability and compatibility knowledge.
supporting_modules.tests/: Regression, compatibility, extraction, viewport, and live-integration tests.

path_assumptions.fact: RHINOCODE defaults to /Applications/Rhino 8.app/Contents/Resources/bin/rhinocode and is overrideable with RHINOCODE_PATH.
Persistent jobs default to ~/Library/Caches/rhino-cad-mcp/jobs and are overrideable with RHINO_MCP_JOB_DIR.
Multiple JSON fixtures and receipts contain absolute /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp paths.

secret_like_path_scan.claim_scope: Filename/path scan only; file contents were not treated as proof that secrets are absent.

integration_points.recommendation: Add the durable Git controller/operator protocol as a separate control-plane directory; .bridge does not currently exist and does not collide with Rhino runtime modules.
Add synchronization and operator-branch preparation outside the MCP runtime; no existing sync or exchange script was found.
Leave server.py as the thin MCP surface and bridge.py as the rhinocode transport. The Git bridge should orchestrate work around them, not replace or import into them.
Treat these as existing application components and migration payload; preserve their imports and Rhino/Grasshopper semantics unchanged during transport migration.
These paths are absent and can be introduced later for review policy or Codex-specific metadata only after the basic Git exchange is proven in the real repository.

blockers.evidence: The tracked tree is clean, but Git reports ?? .venv/ containing 1,478 untracked files.
blockers.impact: Safe branch preparation and migration tooling should not proceed until the virtual environment is explicitly excluded or otherwise handled without deleting it.

blockers.evidence: origin already points to https://github.com/NESDUB/rhino-cad-mcp.git on main with upstream origin/main.
blockers.impact: The intended controller-visible owner/remote must be selected deliberately; do not overwrite the existing remote implicitly.

blockers.evidence: bridge.py and test_bridge.py are active Rhino transport files; backup copies also exist.
blockers.impact: A generic Git bridge named bridge.py would overwrite working MCP/Rhino behavior. Use .bridge/ and exchange.sh instead.

blockers.evidence: Tracked test fixtures and receipts contain /Users/nes/bin/mcp/rhino-cad-mcp paths; bridge.py also has a macOS Rhino default path, although RHINOCODE_PATH can override it.
blockers.impact: Migration validation must distinguish configurable runtime defaults from machine-specific generated artifacts.

blockers.evidence: codex mcp get rhino-cad-mcp reports that no server with that name is registered; rhino-atlas is registered separately.
blockers.impact: The intended MCP registration name and launch command must be confirmed before cutover.

exclusions.reason: Local environment and generated cache/metadata files; .venv is presently untracked and not ignored.
Credential and secret-bearing candidates must remain out of Git; no matching paths were found in the bounded filename scan, but exclusions should be preventive.
Persistent transient job state lives outside the repository and can contain runtime scripts/results; never migrate it as source.
Generated validation artifacts need an explicit artifact-retention policy and path normalization before being committed.

recommended_migration_steps: Preserve the current real repository and remote; perform all migration work on a new operator branch from a verified clean base.
Before branch automation, update ignore policy to exclude .venv/, environment/credential patterns, caches, and transient runtime artifacts without deleting local data.
Resolve the intended repository owner and remote relationship between NESDUB/rhino-cad-mcp and the controller-visible decoded1 account before changing origin.
Port the proven .bridge/ protocol and exchange.sh as an out-of-process control plane; do not replace bridge.py or alter server.py imports.
Preserve RHINOCODE_PATH and RHINO_MCP_JOB_DIR overrides; classify or normalize tracked test artifacts containing /Users/nes absolute paths.
Add a migration request that records base/result/receipt commits and requires review on an operator branch before any merge.
Confirm the desired Codex MCP registration name and launch command, then register or update it only after repository migration is reviewed.
Run non-mutating schema/import checks first; defer live Rhino geometry tests until a separately authorized phase with Rhino state inspection and validation safeguards.
Review and merge through GitHub only after controller verification; retain the existing MCP/Rhino implementation as the rollback point.
